title: Frankfurt-2 Dedicated Launch: burstable GPU family + hybrid-reservation SKUs
creator: Aisha Khan
description: Plan and coordinate the go-to-market for the Dedicated capacity launch in eu-central-2 (Frankfurt-2) introducing the new burstable GPU family (L4x-burst) and hybrid-reservation SKUs (reserved + burst credits). Goal: enable predictable committed throughput for enterprise customers while offering cost-effective burst options for spiky workloads. This ticket coordinates PM deliverables, release notes, console copy, pricing matrix, partner comms, and cross-team readiness (Engineering, Pricing, Legal, Sales Eng, Docs, Support).
